name: Code-Level Corpus, Evidence, and Representation Graph
description: Project-scoped corpus compactions and settled Representation revisions, with DiagramSets retained only as candidate-generation sessions.

codeEntities.label: DiagramStore
codeEntities.summary: Owns the filesystem-backed persistence root and the operations that read and write workspace records.

codeEntities.label: DiagramStore.loadWorkspace
codeEntities.summary: Materializes the project, DiagramSets, evidence collections, artifacts, mappings, runs, and refinement state into one snapshot.

codeEntities.label: WorkspaceSnapshot
codeEntities.summary: Aggregates the persisted and imported records consumed by the application UI.

codeEntities.label: ProjectRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists repository identity, domain profile, concrete corpus binding, and owned DiagramSet identifiers.

codeEntities.label: DiagramSetRecord
codeEntities.summary: Joins one evidence collection to its diagrams, components, runs, batches, and readiness lifecycle.

codeEntities.label: CorpusBinding
codeEntities.summary: Discriminates Git-worktree and filesystem-document corpora and records their concrete roots.

codeEntities.label: corpusProvider
codeEntities.summary: Selects the readable runtime provider for a persisted corpus binding.

codeEntities.label: CodeEntitiesSetRecord
codeEntities.summary: Owns the revisioned CodeEntity evidence collection and its collection lifecycle state.

codeEntities.label: CodeEntityRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists one named evidence entity together with ownership, category, summary, and source anchors.

codeEntities.label: SourceRange
codeEntities.summary: Anchors evidence to exact corpus lines and optionally retains immutable source and compaction metadata.

codeEntities.label: DiagramRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists complete ASCII, representation semantics, evidence membership, provenance, and derivation lineage.

codeEntities.label: DiagramCodeEntityMapRecord
codeEntities.summary: Binds an exact artifact revision to its spatial evidence mappings using artifact identity and ASCII hash.

codeEntities.label: DiagramElementMapping
codeEntities.summary: Connects one visible ASCII span to a CodeEntity and one of its stable or indexed source ranges.

codeEntities.label: buildRepresentationIndex
codeEntities.summary: Builds the explicitly requested tree or diagram runtime index for one revision-pinned ASCII artifact.

codeEntities.label: RepresentationIndex
codeEntities.summary: Unifies the tree and free-form diagram indexes produced for a representation revision.

codeEntities.label: TreeRepresentationNode
codeEntities.summary: Represents one stable tree node with hierarchy, spatial line identity, mappings, and evidence links.

codeEntities.label: DiagramRepresentationElement
codeEntities.summary: Represents one exact free-form diagram element and its evidence links at ASCII coordinates.

codeEntities.label: EvidenceElementLink
codeEntities.summary: Carries the evidence identity and stable or indexed source-range identity attached to a representation element.

codeEntities.label: GenerationSessionRecord
codeEntities.summary: Names DiagramSet compatibility records by their peripheral role: collecting Evidence and producing candidate artifacts.

codeEntities.label: ProjectFileCompactionRecord
codeEntities.summary: Stores one immutable, source-hashed file compaction independently of a generation session.

codeEntities.label: ProjectCorpusCompactionCatalogRecord
codeEntities.summary: Owns Project-wide compaction history and the active compaction for each corpus path.

codeEntities.label: ProjectRepresentationRevisionRecord
codeEntities.summary: Snapshots immutable settled ASCII, Evidence, spatial mappings, and optional source-session provenance.

codeEntities.label: ProjectRepresentationRecord
codeEntities.summary: Provides the durable settled Representation identity and current immutable revision.

codeEntities.label: ProjectRepresentationCatalogRecord
codeEntities.summary: Owns settled Representations and active selections by view kind at Project scope.

codeEntities.label: ProjectCatalogStore
codeEntities.summary: Persists Project-level corpus compactions and settled Representation revisions outside generation sessions.

codeEntities.label: ProjectCatalogStore.upsertFileCompaction
codeEntities.summary: Content-addresses and persists a file compaction, optionally selecting it for the live Project path.

codeEntities.label: ProjectCatalogStore.promoteRepresentation
codeEntities.summary: Creates or reuses an immutable settled revision and updates the Project Representation catalog.

codeEntities.label: DiagramApplication.promoteProjectRepresentation
codeEntities.summary: Snapshots a generated candidate and its Evidence/mappings into the settled Project catalog.

diagrams.name: Project Corpus and Settled Representations
diagrams.ascii:
Legend: [P] persisted, [R] runtime, [X] external content.

             PROJECT-SCOPED CORPUS AND SETTLED REPRESENTATIONS

[P] ProjectRecord
 |
 +--> corpus -----------------------> [P] CorpusBinding
 |                                        |
 |                              [R] function corpusProvider(...)
 |                                        |
 |                                        v
 |                             [X] Git worktree / documents
 |
 +--> catalogs ---------------------> [R] ProjectCatalogStore
 |                                        |
 |              +-------------------------+-------------------------+
 |              |                                                   |
 |              v                                                   v
 | [P] ProjectCorpusCompactionCatalogRecord       [P] ProjectRepresentationCatalogRecord
 |     activeByPath[path]                              activeByKind[viewKind]
 |              |                                                   |
 |              v                                                   v
 | [P] ProjectFileCompactionRecord                  [P] ProjectRepresentationRecord
 |     source hash + profile + sections                  currentRevisionId
 |              ^                                                   |
 |              | method upsertFileCompaction(...)                  v
 |              |                               [P] ProjectRepresentationRevisionRecord
 |              |                                   immutable ASCII + Evidence + mappings
 |              |                                                   |
 |              |                                                   v
 |              |                                [R] function buildRepresentationIndex(...)
 |
 `--> [P] GenerationSessionRecord
      compatibility storage: DiagramSetRecord
      owns CodeEntities + candidate Diagrams + runs
                         |
                         | method promoteProjectRepresentation(...)
                         v
                  [R] ProjectCatalogStore
                         |
                         `--> method promoteRepresentation(...)
                              snapshots candidate + Evidence + mappings
                              into the immutable settled revision above

SESSION DELETION BOUNDARY
Generation Session removed ----X----> Project compactions / settled Representations
